name: lib/http
description: HTTP as a headless program speaks it: the request and response headers, and a client that fetches or streams.
residual: Split out of lib/net-clients 2026-09-04, when the sound package went into the payload and dragged these two in behind it: a payload that carries a module whose own package says it does not belong there is a payload that has stopped agreeing with the manifests. The rest of net-clients is finished programs and stays where it is.

TFLog comes with them and stays in lib/diagnostics, which went headless the same day: it is a log file, not an HTTP anything, and putting it here to shorten a dependency would be filing by accident rather than by subject.
